summary: Verification round (review-scope.mjs: 13 of 94 parts changed, 14%, sections and objectives unchanged); validate and lint --strict are clean, and measure.mjs gives prose 2,388 and est 17.3 min. Both round-2 must-fix items are resolved: q2 has to be answered from s2-b4's JSON, and ex-split gives saving to the backend as 1-1 does; with the new q0 option, the wider ex-verify troubleshoot and the commit model answer, hook, prior, active, miscon and accuracy rise to 4. No new must-fix; what is left below 4 is the two-level hint ladder in the practice, the crowded 1-2 segment and wording the ja-editor owns.
